subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: American astronaut, aerospace engineer Neil Armstrong was born in Wapakoneta. He was the first man to walk on the moon. He received his BSc in aeronautical engineering and MSc in aerouspace engineering. He with his group launched the mission to the moon with Apollo 11.
